selected_assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: professional PHOTOGRAPHIC character turnaround reference sheet, not a film still and not a storyboard. Reference image 1 is the sole identity and wardrobe source for the fictional adult woman. Reference image 2 is NOT needed for shoes: shoes will be provided separately downstream.
Make a high-resolution landscape sheet in a precise 2-by-2 grid of four full-length STUDIO PHOTOGRAPHS of the SAME young Chinese woman from reference image 1, with matching face, age, skin, low black ponytail, tiny silver stud earrings, build and proportions. Her fixed outfit is exactly the sage-green short-sleeved cardigan worn open, plain white crew-neck tee and light-blue straight ankle-length jeans from the reference. For this BODY ASSET remove the shoes and have her wear plain white ankle socks: footwear identity is a separate product asset, so do not bake the new shoes into the character before the story purchase.
Top-left: straight front view. Top-right: true LEFT profile looking toward the left edge. Bottom-left: true RIGHT profile looking toward the right edge. Bottom-right: straight rear view. Exactly four views, not four different people. Each panel fills most of its height with the whole body from top of ponytail to sock-covered feet, all limbs visible, no cropping, consistent head height and scale, ordinary healthy adult anatomy. Relaxed neutral upright stance, arms gently separated from torso so cardigan shape, hands and both legs are readable, no fashion pose. Face has neutral-friendly closed mouth, no dramatic smile. Rear view shows ponytail, back of cardigan and jeans; profiles genuinely show opposite sides, do not repeat front three-quarter images.
Plain seamless LIGHT GRAY studio background and same soft neutral frontal light in every panel; no room, no furniture, no dog, no tablet, no brand, no decorative scene, no arbitrary accessories. Use natural photographic lens perspective (85mm), not illustration or engineering drawing, crisp realistic skin/knit/denim texture, no glamour smoothing, no CGI. Add only tiny black labels underneath each panel: FRONT, LEFT, RIGHT, BACK. Clean narrow grid gutters, no large border or logo. Landscape aspect ratio 4:3, largest practical resolution. The grid is only for comparison and identity reference; it is not four shots of a story.
exclude: white socks as final story footwear
selected_assets.qa: All four requested directions visible, same cardigan/jeans/ponytail, feet not cropped. White socks intentionally separate identity from old/new shoes.

selected_assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single PHOTOGRAPHIC prop design reference sheet for the same ONE unbranded realistic 10-inch dark charcoal-gray tablet with black bezel and a matching charcoal tri-fold protective case. Three equal panel STUDIO product photos, arranged horizontally, showing FRONT, BACK, and SIDE of the exact same object. The tablet is portrait orientation in all views, width-to-height 2:3, evenly rounded corners, thin black screen bezel, a tiny front-facing camera centered at the top bezel, a single small rear camera at upper left, no visible logos or text, matte dark gray body. The case folds into a stable triangular support behind the tablet, so it is always one tablet+case assembly; in side profile the triangle behind it is clearly legible and supports an approximately 65-degree screen angle from the horizontal floor. Front and back views show the SAME standing assembly rotated around its vertical axis for inspection, no orientation flip or new stand design. FRONT: camera sees the actual front black inactive screen with only soft neutral reflection, case mostly behind it. BACK: camera sees the matte rear of tablet and the same folded-case support, the rear camera position remains at object's top-left. SIDE: clearly show the tablet's thin edge, bezel/screen layer, rear case and triangular support structure in profile. The screen and the back are always distinct opposite sides; NEVER show a touchscreen printed on the back. Physical dimensions and proportions identical across all views, camera and case openings mechanically plausible. Plain pale-gray studio backdrop and tabletop, consistent neutral soft product light, realistic material texture and true soft shadows, no cartoon or schematic drawings. Whole object and all corners inside each panel, no people, dog, room, hands, shopping content, lettering, logos or extra devices. Tiny bottom panel labels FRONT, BACK, SIDE only. Landscape reference sheet about 4:3. This prop sheet defines one canonical tablet for downstream story shots; its front screen must face the user/dog during use, even if the camera then sees the tablet back.
selected_assets.qa: Front/back/side distinguish screen from casing, front and rear camera positions, and triangular support. Touchscreen faces dog in use, not automatically camera.

selected_assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve environment extraction. Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the apartment environment/material palette, not the woman, not her shoes, not her pose or original crop. Create ONE empty, believable real-world Chinese young woman's modest apartment living-room location reference photograph, WITHOUT people or animals and WITHOUT the tablet, shoes or plot props.
Preserve the room's visual world: light-oak plank floor, off-white warm-neutral walls, a normal beige woven fabric sofa along the back-right wall, a plain low rectangular oak coffee table in front of sofa, oatmeal woven rug under sofa/table, tall daylight window on the left wall with pale linen curtains, low oak plant console under that window, one slim oak open bookcase with books and trailing green plant at the back-left corner, one small framed pale-toned landscape print on the right wall. Keep ordinary well-loved home scale (roughly 3.5m x 4.5m), no grand loft, no luxury mansion. The same main furniture silhouettes and simple cushions as reference. Include a glimpse of an open doorway near the far RIGHT edge leading toward the entry hall; do not duplicate windows or furniture.
Camera from living-room entrance/front-left, eye height about1.2m, natural 28mm lens, wide view with vertical walls straight, full sofa/table/window and main circulation space readable. Make the foreground open oak floor a clear playable zone for a 28cm-shoulder corgi and floor-level tablet; coffee table stays further back beside sofa, not obstructing the dog's future foreground action. Empty room with realistic soft window daylight and normal neutral white balance, natural photographic texture in wood/linen/knit cushion/fabric, enough depth of field to identify spatial anchors. Elegant simple domestic lifestyle-ad setting, no CGI, no cartoon, no visible reflections of people, no dog, no human, no product shoes, no tablet, no staged human story. No text, captions, floor-plan drawings or panel grid. Landscape 16:9 high-resolution photograph. This is a LOCATION ASSET for later casting characters into different shots, not a finished frame.
selected_assets.qa: Empty room, no baked-in character/dog/shoes/tablet. Window/sofa/bookcase and entry opening are visible spatial anchors.

selected_assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: EMPTY residential walking-path LOCATION reference, for a live-action Chinese young woman and her corgi in an everyday comfortable-shoe short comedy. One believable contemporary Chinese residential community courtyard, no resort or European arches. A flat medium-gray stone-tile pedestrian path about3m wide enters from foreground and leads toward a simple fork in the middle distance. One ordinary natural-wood slat bench with dark metal legs sits on camera-left foreground by low green shrubs, clearly visible seat/backrest/ground contact, with open ground beside it where a person and dog could stop. Several green shade trees form a relaxed canopy, planted beds and grass edges, one small flat walking route at the fork rather than stairs or a sports track. Pale beige ordinary apartment buildings subtly visible behind greenery in distance, not a luxury estate. Soft bright late-afternoon natural light and gentle dappled shadows; normal neutral color, clean but lived-in residential place. Camera eye height1.2m from along path, 35mm lens, straight perspective, clear bench-to-path-to-fork spatial anchors, natural depth of field so main scene layout is readable. The open gray paving will make bright white shoes stand out in later shots; do not insert any shoes now. Photograph textures of wood, bark, leaves and gray tiles realistic. Entire scene is EMPTY: no people, no animals, no tablets, no shoes, no signs, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no magic, no extreme blur, no cartoon or CG. Landscape16:9 reference photograph, no panels or storyboards. This is one canonical place to be reused for the uncomfortable old-shoe walk and the comfortable new-shoe walk, not different parks each time.
selected_assets.qa: Empty ordinary residential path, visible bench and fork; reused for before/after walks to support story continuity.

selected_assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic prop identity reference PHOTO of a matched left and right pair of fictional unbranded women's everyday OLD SHOES for a short comedy. These are not the advertised Beiqiang shoes and not identifiable competitor products. Two ordinary charcoal-taupe gray low-top canvas-textile lace-up casual shoes, simple muted gray laces, flat narrow low dark-gray soles, rounded toes, no logos or graphics. Clean but clearly previously worn through subtle fabric creases and minor sole-edge scuffing; no holes, torn seams, deformed soles or dramatic damage, no performance infographic. The fictional owner has personally found these shoes uncomfortable after a long walk; the picture itself must not pretend to prove that. Shoes look normal and plausible, not villainous. A real left/right pair arranged on a plain pale-gray studio surface, one in a three-quarter side view and the other more front-facing, full soles and heels inside frame, realistic wearable proportions, soft neutral product light, crisp textile and lace details. Distinct from the story's NEW white knit laceless slip-ons: keep these gray and visibly lace-up. No people, feet, dog, room, text, watermark, claims or brand. One studio product photograph, not a collage or grid. Landscape4:3. This is a reusable fictional prop asset for the pre-purchase shots, not actual SKU evidence.

reference_usage.mode: LibTV Seedance2.5 image2video reference configured; 13 connected inputs; no generation submitted or authorized
reference_usage.boards: Use boards as identity/design references, never as first frame or storyboard unless explicitly intended. Declare all views depict one subject. Do not inherit labels/grids/poses/background.
reference_usage.selection: Select only useful assets per scene. Reference count maximum is not a target. If total entity count or board ambiguity requires independent angle images, derive those deliberately at preparation stage rather than filling the input limit.
reference_usage.example: Images1-2: the same woman, body/wardrobe and face respectively. Image3: the only corgi, including vest. Image4: actual new shoe. Image5: only tablet prop. Images6-8: living room, entry and walkway, as applicable. Renumber against actual CLI upload order at submission; semantic asset IDs are not provider-native tokens.
reference_usage.before_after: Character body has neutral white socks, not permanently attached new shoe. Script assigns unbranded old shoes before delivery and real BQ028 White after delivery.
reference_usage.contact: Tablet front faces dog; camera may see back. Four canine paws/joints remain natural. Static board does not validate a tap or a whole walk.
